in_greek.name: Δέβηρα

in_latin.name: Debera
in_latin.long_meaning: Debera originem habet ex hebraeo nomine Deborah, quod significat apis et precari. In traditione Christiana, nomen Debera coniungitur cum spirituali ductu et oratione. Debera est symbolum spiritualis fortitudinis et ductus.

in_english.name: Debera
in_english.meaning: Debera means bee and she who brings prayer
in_english.long_meaning: Debera originates from the Hebrew name Deborah, meaning bee and she who brings prayer. In Christianity, Debera symbolizes spiritual guidance and prayer. The name is associated with strength, leadership, and devotion. Historically, Deborah was a judge and spiritual leader of Israel, making Debera a powerful and meaningful name in Christian tradition.
